Hi Samira —

We missed you on today's runbook sync — hope everything is okay on your side. Quick recap from our side: we planned to walk through production failover, KV cache behavior for long-tail queries, and a short collection of latency numbers from your qps profile. I attached a 1-page discovery summary for reference.

To get back on track, can you do one of the following (tight windows so we can keep this focused):
- Thu May 14, 12:00–12:30 PT (lunch window, 30m)
- Thu May 14, 12:15–12:45 PT (30m) — this helps if your SRE can join slightly later
- Fri May 15, 16:30–16:45 PT (15m compressed deep-dive)

If none of those work, please tell me the single best 30-minute window next week and we will lock it. We want to include an SE for the technical bit — Ben is our primary SE; I copied Marissa to help with scheduling.

Quick asks from us:
- Confirm attendees (SRE or Ops lead)
- If you want us to focus only on a specific runbook section, say which one

If I don't hear back in 24 hours we'll release the lunch windows and open a few later slots — prefer a firm yes/no so we can protect engineering time.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
